8. ALTERNATIVES TO THE PROPOSED ACTION
8.3.1 Long Spur Ridge Site
In evaluating the Long Spur Ridge Site, the statement assumes the capacity of the pumped storage installation at this site as 1000 MW, same as for 
33^4
 Lreek. In the Applicant's opinion, it would be uneconomic not to realize the full potential of the Long Spur Ridge site, which is capable of supporting a 2200 MW 
\pm
 installation. It is probable that this site can be utilized in the future on a more economic basis when the technology for high head pumped storage turbines has been proven and a pumped storage station of this size will be needed for optimum dispatch of power in the Duke system
The preferred higher capacity for the Long Spur Ridge Site has been discussed in Section 8.3.
